BiblicalUsage: Hurtful is the word for injurious, and it appears once, in Paul's warning about riches. In 1 Timothy 6:9 they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition. One word, for the lusts that drown.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's word is exact: hurtful lusts do not merely wound, they drown.
